renames.NLAlib/Gaussian/Basic.lean: holds the definition of gaussianMatrix and its entry-level API; 'Basic' would read as scalar Gaussian basics inside Probability/Gaussian/Basic
renames.NLAlib/Gaussian/Moments.lean: Moments/Moments.lean says nothing; the file is E||SGT||_F^2 (atlas gaussian-frob-second-moment) plus almost-sure full rank

notes: Group M3: 72 content files under NLAlib/Gaussian (the 4 aggregators Gaussian/{Comparison,Concentration,Extreme,InverseMoments}.lean and NLAlib/Gaussian.lean are left for regeneration). 32 go to Probability (layer 1), 40 to RandomMatrix (layer 2).
InverseMoments/ (21 files) moved wholesale to RandomMatrix/Gaussian/InverseMoments, including its scalar helpers (WeakInequality, HardEdgeEndpoint, GammaBounds, SchurComplement).

Comparison/ moved wholesale to Probability/Gaussian/Comparison except ExpectationNormDiff (E||g_N|| - E||g_n|| >= sqrt N - sqrt n, a chi moment fact) -> Probability/Gaussian/Moments; SlepianTails joins it.

Concentration/ is split: IntegrationByParts, Stein, OrnsteinUhlenbeck, OrnsteinUhlenbeckEntropy -> Probability/Gaussian/Calculus (with the top-level OU*Growth and *IntegrationByParts files); LogSobolev*, LipschitzConcentration -> Probability/Gaussian/Concentration (with LogSobolevCoverage, LogSobolevHerbst).

Extreme/ is split: ChiSquare -> Probability/ChiSquare; Gordon, Deviation, SmallBall, SpectralSecondMoment, Chevet -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Spectral; Lipschitz, LinearForms -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Basic.

Layer check done on the Gaussian-internal import graph: no file sent to Probability imports a file sent to RandomMatrix. External importers of Gaussian files are all in Sketching, LowRank, Estimation (layer >= 3). No content file imports a Gaussian aggregator.

Verified by compiling scratch copies (no repo edits): CovarianceRepresentation and PolynomialLinearMoments compile with `import NLAlib.Gaussian.Basic` replaced by Basic's own Mathlib imports, and PolynomialGrowthIntegrationByParts compiles without `import NLAlib.Gaussian.Moments.FourthMoment` (with FourthMoment's Mathlib imports). ProductIntegrationByParts genuinely uses `hasGaussianLaw_id_pi_gaussianReal` from Gaussian/Basic.
flags: DECISION FOR REVIEW: NLAlib/Gaussian/Basic.lean (defines gaussianMatrix) -> Probability/Gaussian/Basic/GaussianMatrix.lean, against the brief's 'gaussianMatrix -> RandomMatrix'. Reason: with today's imports, putting Basic in RandomMatrix forces 16 scalar/vector files into RandomMatrix (CovarianceRepresentation, PolynomialLinearMoments, WickPairings, Isserlis, PolynomialGrowthIntegrationByParts, ProductIntegrationByParts, OrnsteinUhlenbeckGrowth, OrnsteinUhlenbeckEntropyGrowth, SeriesPolynomialMoments, Khintchine, SeriesKhintchine, SeriesSecondMoment, LogSobolevHerbst, and the mixed LipschitzConcentration/FourthMoment). The couplings are: CovarianceRepresentation and PolynomialLinearMoments import Basic without using any of its declarations; PolynomialGrowthIntegrationByParts imports FourthMoment without using it; ProductIntegrationByParts uses the vector lemma hasGaussianLaw_id_pi_gaussianReal (Basic l.183); LipschitzConcentration ends with the gaussianMatrix corollary gaussian_concentration. A small pre-move housekeeping patch restores the brief: move hasGaussianLaw_id_pi_gaussianReal into a Probability file, drop the 3 unused imports, split gaussian_concentration into a RandomMatrix file (only Extreme/Deviation uses it). Then Basic -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Basic/Basic.lean and FourthMoment -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments, and everything else in this table is unchanged.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Moments/FourthMoment.lean: mixed. Scalar moments (integrable_pow_gaussianReal, E X^3 = 0, E X^4 = 3), entry-level Isserlis for an i.i.d. array, and the matrix identity E||SGT||_F^4 (atlas gaussian-frob-fourth-moment). Placed in Probability/Gaussian/Moments because PolynomialGrowthIntegrationByParts imports it (see the decision above); the matrix part should split to RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments later.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Concentration/LipschitzConcentration.lean: mixed. Dominant gaussian_concentration_pi (Probability/Gaussian/Concentration) plus the gaussianMatrix corollary gaussian_concentration (~25 lines, used only by Extreme/Deviation); split later to RandomMatrix/Gaussian.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Moments.lean -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments/SecondMoment.lean: mixed. Second moment E||SGT||_F^2 plus almost-sure full rank (gaussian-full-rank-ae, ae_ne_zero_mvPolynomial); the rank part belongs with SketchRank in RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Spectral; split later.

NLAlib/Gaussian/LogOverlap.lean, LogOverlapMoments.lean: Gaussian start-vector log-overlap (vector content, used by LowRank/RandomStart*). Forced into RandomMatrix because LogOverlap imports Extreme.LinearForms and Invariance (one proof routes through gaussianMatrix 1 n); LogOverlapMoments also uses Hermitian eigenvector bases. Placed in RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments; would fit Probability/Gaussian/Moments after removing that import.

NLAlib/Gaussian/{Khintchine,SeriesKhintchine,SeriesSecondMoment,SeriesPolynomialMoments}.lean: noncommutative Khintchine / matrix-series moments (SeriesKhintchine and SeriesSecondMoment cover Rademacher coefficients too). Placed in Probability/Gaussian/Moments per the brief; Probability/Concentration/Matrix, next to M2's Series/RademacherKhintchine and Series/PolynomialMoment, is the alternative home. Coordinate with M2.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Moments/ApproxMultiplication.lean: Gaussian approximate matrix multiplication (atlas gaussian-amm) is a sketch guarantee; kept in RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments per the brief; Sketching/Properties/ApproxMatrixMultiplication is the alternative (nothing imports it, so either is layer-safe).

NLAlib/Gaussian/InverseMoments/** (wholesale): about 12 of the 21 files are the hard-edge / lambda_min(GG^T) subsystem (WeakInequality, GaussianWeakInequality, UnshiftedWeakInequality, HardEdgeEndpoint, OperatorHardEdge, Cutoff*, Regularized*, ResolventLimit, LambdaMinTail), which is a Wishart spectral result; it could move to RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Wishart later. WeakInequality, HardEdgeEndpoint and GammaBounds are scalar and import nothing from RandomMatrix.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Conditioning.lean -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Moments: starts with generic Fubini-for-independent-variables lemmas (integral_of_indepFun, lintegral_of_indepFun) that belong in Probability/Basic; split later.

NLAlib/Gaussian/Extreme/Lipschitz.lean -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Basic: carries generic helpers (integrable_iSup_of_fintype, integrable_iInf_of_fintype, integral_le_of_integral_sq_le) that belong in Probability/Basic; split later.

NLAlib/Gaussian/LinearImage.lean -> RandomMatrix/Gaussian/Invariance: includes the scalar hasSubgaussianMGF_id_gaussianReal (N(0,v) is sub-Gaussian), which would fit Probability/SubGaussian; split later.
NLAlib/Gaussian/HaarQR.lean -> RandomMatrix/Haar although it mentions gaussianMatrix: its theorem is the Haar frame law (atlas haar-orthogonal). Same layer as RandomMatrix/Gaussian, so this is safe.

NLAlib/Gaussian/DirectionalSquaredNorm.lean -> Probability/ChiSquare: chi-square MGF domination for vectors with directional sub-Gaussian proxies; it exists for SRHT (imported only by Sketching/SRHTFlattening).
